name: PT Singaraja Putra Tbk
summary: PT Singaraja Putra Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wood processing business in the Netherlands, China, Canada, the United States, Australia, Korea, the United Kingdom, Belgium, the Gzech Republic, and the United Arab Emirates. The company operates through Rent Revenue, Sales of Wood, and Sales of Coal segments. It also engages in trading and wood industry; other management consulting; and coal mining services. The company also provides short-term accommodation and hostel services. PT Singaraja Putra Tbk was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Bekasi, Indonesia.
